svg.title: DnsValidatedCertificateV2
svg.desc: A CloudFront distribution serves a private S3 bucket on a custom domain. DnsValidatedCertificateV2 creates its certificate in us-east-1 in a generated stack, validates it with a CNAME in the hosted zone, and passes the ARN back through Fn::GetStackOutput.
